pathway_zh: 起於小腹內，下出會陰，沿脊柱正中上行（過命門、大椎），至項後風府，入絡腦，上頂（百會），沿前額下鼻柱，至唇繫帶（齦交）。總督全身陽經，為「陽脈之海」。
pathway_en: Originates in the lower abdomen, emerges at the perineum, ascends along the midline of the spine (passing GV 4 Mingmen, GV 14 Dazhui) to GV 16 Fengfu at the nape, enters the brain, ascends to the vertex (GV 20 Baihui), descends along the forehead and nasal bridge, ending at the frenulum of the upper lip (GV 28 Yinjiao). Governs all Yang channels ('Sea of Yang Vessels').
indications_zh: 神志與腦病：昏迷、癲癇、中風、失眠、焦慮、頭痛、頭暈。
脊柱與腰背病症：腰脊強痛、角弓反張、後頭痛。
陽氣虛衰：畏寒肢冷、陽痿、脫肛、遺尿。
indications_en: Mental & Brain disorders: Coma, epilepsy, stroke, insomnia, anxiety, headache, dizziness.
Spinal & Back disorders: Lumbar/spinal stiffness and pain, opisthotonos, occipital headache.
Yang Deficiency disorders: Aversion to cold, cold limbs, impotence, rectal prolapse, enuresis.
applications_zh: 主司督率陽氣，開竅醒腦，通脊強腰，昇陽舉陷。
百會（頭頂安神提升）、命門（補腎陽要穴）、大椎（解熱要穴/諸陽之會）、人中（水溝/急救甦厥第一要穴）。
applications_en: Governs all Yang Qi, opening orifices, restoring consciousness, strengthening spine/lumbar, and raising Yang.
Core points: GV 20 Baihui (raises Yang & calms Shen), GV 4 Mingmen (primary Kidney Yang tonic), GV 14 Dazhui (clears heat / Meeting of Yang), GV 26 Renzhong (primary emergency resuscitation point).
seam_anatomy_zh:
【體內循行路線】
起於小腹內，下出會陰，沿脊柱內部上行，經項後入腦，上頂，沿前額下行至鼻柱，止於上唇系帶處（齦交）。
qihua_zh:
【督脈氣化與陽脈之海】
督脈總督全身陽氣，稱為「陽脈之海」。主脊髓與腦，與神志、精神、升陽固脫密切相關。
pathomechanism_zh: 脊柱強直、角弓反張、頭痛、頭暈、癲狂、發熱、神志病、陽痿、遺精。
preservation_zh: 按揉百會 DU20 升陽舉陷、按揉大椎 DU14 退熱解表、捏脊保養督脈。

pathway_zh: 起於小腹內胞宮，下出會陰（會陰），沿腹部正中線上行（關元、氣海、中脘），過胸部（膻中），上喉嚨（天突），至下唇（承漿），環繞口唇，分支上抵目眶下。總任全身陰經，為「陰脈之海」，主胞胎與生育機能。
pathway_en: Originates in the uterus/pelvis, emerges at the perineum (CV 1 Huiyin), ascends the midline of the abdomen (CV 4 Guanyuan, CV 6 Qihai, CV 12 Zhongwan) and chest (CV 17 Danzhong), up the throat (CV 22 Tiantu) to the lower lip (CV 24 Chengjiang), encircling the mouth to below the eye. Governs all Yin channels ('Sea of Yin Vessels') and fertility.
indications_zh: 婦科與生殖病症：月經不調、痛經、崩漏、帶下、不孕、產後諸疾。
脾胃與腸胃病症：胃痛、腹脹、腹痛、嘔吐、腹瀉、便秘。
胸肺病症：咳嗽、氣喘、胸悶、胸痛。
indications_en: Gynecological & fertility disorders: Dysmenorrhea, irregular menses, metrorrhagia, leukorrhea, infertility.
GI & Digestive disorders: Gastralgia, abdominal distension/pain, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation.
Chest & Lung disorders: Cough, asthma, chest tightness/pain.
applications_zh: 主司調養陰血，培補元氣，溫陽固脫，調理生育與腹部臟腑。
關元與氣海（培補元氣、強壯第一要穴）、中脘（腑會/胃募穴）、膻中（氣會/心包募穴）、天突（利咽平喘要穴）。
applications_en: Governs nourishing Yin & Blood, tonifying Original Qi, warming Yang to prevent prostration, regulating fertility and abdominal organs.
Core points: CV 4 Guanyuan & CV 6 Qihai (primary Yuan-Qi tonics), CV 12 Zhongwan (Fu-Hui / Stomach Front-Mu), CV 17 Danzhong (Qi-Hui / Pericardium Front-Mu), CV 22 Tiantu (asthma & sore throat).
seam_anatomy_zh:
【體內循行路線】
起於小腹內胞宮，下出會陰，沿前正中向上，經陰毛、腹部、胸部、頸部，止於下唇頦唇溝（承漿）。
qihua_zh:
【任脈氣化與陰脈之海】
任脈總任全身陰經氣血，稱為「陰脈之海」。主胞胎與生殖。
pathomechanism_zh: 疝氣、帶下、瘕聚、月經不調、不孕、小便不利、胸腹脹痛。
preservation_zh: 按揉中脘 REN12 健脾和胃、按揉氣海 REN6 補氣、按揉關元 REN4 補陽滋陰。

element: Yin/Yang / 十二經脈之海・血海
pathway_zh: 起於小腹胞宮內，下出會陰，經氣衝（ST30），平行於足少陰腎經（KI11-KI21），沿腹部夾臍兩側上行，散於胸中。分支上循咽喉，環繞口唇。為「十二經脈之海」與「血海」。
pathway_en: Points of the Chong channel include: SP 4 Gongsun, ST 30 Qichong, KI 11 Henggu through KI 21 Youmen. Ascends parallel to Kidney Channel on abdomen to chest.
indications_zh: 婦科病症：月經不調、痛經、崩漏、閉經、不孕、產後血暈。
腸胃與心胸病症：奔豚氣、胃痛、嘔吐、腹痛、腹脹、胸悶、心悸。
indications_en: Irregular menses, dysmenorrhea, metrorrhagia, amenorrhea, infertility, postpartum dizziness.
Running piglet syndrome, gastralgia, vomiting, abdominal pain/distension, chest tightness, palpitations.
applications_zh: 調節全身十二經脈氣血，為「血海」與「十二經之海」。
調理婦科月經、胎產與生殖機能，平降上逆之氣。
applications_en: Regulates Qi and Blood of all 12 channels ('Sea of Blood' and 'Sea of 12 Meridians').
Regulates menses, pregnancy, fertility, and lowers rebellious Qi.

pathway_zh: 起於季脅下方（章門），斜下繞腰腹一圈（如束腰帶），行於帶脈（GB26）、五樞（GB27）、維道（GB28）穴。總束全身縱行諸經脈。
pathway_en: Points of the Dai channel include: GB 41 Zulinqi, TE 5 Waiguan, GB 26 Daimai, GB 27 Wushu, GB 28 Weidao, LR 13 Zhangmen. Circles waist like a belt.
indications_zh: 帶下與婦科病症：赤白帶下、子宮脫垂、月經不調、痛經、腰痛如折。
下肢與少腹病症：少腹痛、腰膝酸軟、下肢痿痺、疝氣。
indications_en: Red and white leukorrhea, uterine prolapse, irregular menses, dysmenorrhea, severe lumbar pain.
Lower abdominal pain, lumbar/knee soreness, weakness in lower limbs, hernia.
applications_zh: 總束全身縱行經脈，固攝帶下與胎孕。
調理婦科與腰腹機能。
applications_en: Binds all vertical meridians, restrains leukorrhea, supports pregnancy.
Regulates gynecological and waist/abdominal functions.

element: Yang / 主肢體運動與司睜眼
pathway_zh: 起於足跟外側（申脈），經仆參、跗陽，沿腿外側上行，經股骨大轉子（居髎）、肩胛（臑俞、肩髃、巨骨）、面頰（地倉、巨髎、承泣），至目內眥（睛明），與陰蹻脈相會，沿頭經風池入腦。
pathway_en: Points of the Yangqiao channel include: BL 62 Shenmai, BL 61 Pucan, BL 59 Fuyang, GB 29 Juliao, LI 16 Jugu, LI 15 Jianyu, SI 10 Naoshu, ST 4 Dicang, ST 3 Juliao, ST 1 Chengqi, BL 1 Jingming, GB 20 Fengchi. Originates at lateral heel, ascends lateral leg, hip, shoulder, cheek to inner canthus and brain.
indications_zh: 神志與睡眠病症：失眠（目張不瞑）、日間癲癇、躁動不安、頭痛、眩暈。
運動與肌肉病症：下肢外側肌肉緊張拘急、內側肌肉鬆弛、足外翻、下肢麻木癱瘓、中風偏癱。
頭面五官病症：面癱、三叉神經痛、目赤腫痛、眼瞼瞤動、口眼歪斜。
背部與關節病症：腰背僵硬痛、肩臂痛、髖關節痛。
indications_en: Insomnia (eyes remaining open), daytime epilepsy, agitation, severe headache, vertigo.
Motor impairment of legs, tightness and spasm along the lateral side of legs with medial side flaccid, eversion of foot, post-stroke hemiplegia.
Bell's palsy, trigeminal neuralgia, red/swollen eyes, eyelid twitching, facial paralysis.
Back stiffness & pain, shoulder pain, hip joint pain.
applications_zh: 司眼瞼開合，調節晝夜睡眠節律（主日間興奮與睜眼）。
控制軀體外側運動機能與肌肉張力。
疏通太陽與陽明經氣，祛風清熱明目。
applications_en: Controls eyelid opening and regulates sleep-wake cycles (daytime alertness).
Controls lateral limb movement and muscle tone.
Unblocks Taiyang and Yangming channel Qi, expels wind, and clears head and eyes.

element: Yin / 主肢體運動與司閉眼
pathway_zh: 起於足跟內側（照海），沿內踝上行，經腿內側、陰部、小腹、胸部、過缺盆，沿喉嚨，上達目內眥（睛明），與陽蹻脈會合入腦。
pathway_en: Points of the Yinqiao (movement) channel include: Zhaohai (KI 6), Jiaoxin (KI 8), Renying (ST 9), Quepen (ST 12), Jingming (BL 1). Originates at the medial heel, ascends the medial malleolus, inner leg, abdomen, chest to throat, ending at inner canthus (BL 1).
indications_zh: 神志與睡眠病症：嗜睡（目瞑怠惰）、夜間癲癇、精神萎靡、失眠、多寐。
下肢與運動病症：下肢內側肌肉緊張拘急、外側鬆弛萎軟、足內翻（足下垂）、下肢痿痺。
少腹與生殖病症：小腹痛、髖關節痛、陰部痛、腰痛、帶下、不孕。
婦產科病症：習慣性流產、難產、崩漏、白帶過多。
indications_en: Hypersomnia, nighttime epilepsy, lethargy, insomnia, somnolence.
Motor impairment of the legs, tightness and spasm along the medial side of the legs with the lateral side flaccid or atrophied, inversion of the foot.
Lower abdominal, hip and genital pain, lower back pain, leukorrhea, infertility.
Habitual miscarriage, difficult labor, vaginal discharge, uterine bleeding.
applications_zh: 影響下肢內側、腹部（多為單側症狀）及眼部。
調節下肢運動與陰陽張弛。
總控全身內側與外側之陰氣。
升提陰液，調節全身陰液代謝（陰精、血液、津液、汗液、淚液及結節病變）。
通利明目，清利頭目。
applications_en: Influences the medial aspect of the legs, abdomen (only unilateral symptoms), and eyes.
Regulates motion of the lower limbs.
Controls Yin on the medial and lateral aspects of the body.
Ascends Yin substances, influences all Yin substances (Yin, blood, fluids, sweat, tears, and nodules).
Benefits the eyes and clears head and vision.

pathway_zh: 起於足外側（金門），經陽交，沿下肢外側、軀體側外、肩部、項後，上至額部（頭維、陽白），折入風池，會於風府與啞門。維絡全身陽經。
pathway_en: Points of the Yangwei channel include: BL 63 Jinmen, GB 35 Yangjiao, GB 21 Jianjing, TE 15 Tianliao, SI 10 Naoshu, ST 8 Touwei, GB 13 Benshen, GB 14 Yangbai, GB 15 Toulinqi, GB 16 Muchuang, GV 16 Fengfu, GV 15 Yamen, GB 17 Zhengying, GB 18 Chengling, GB 19 Naokong, GB 20 Fengchi. Links all Yang channels.
indications_zh: 外感與寒熱病症：寒熱往來、惡寒發熱、無汗或多汗、瘧疾。
頭面與少陽病症：偏頭痛、目赤腫痛、耳鳴耳聾、頸項強痛、面腫。
循行部位病症：腰脊痛、肩背痛、軀體側外肋間神經痛、下肢外側痛。
indications_en: Alternating chills and fever, fever and aversion to cold, anhidrosis/hyperhidrosis, malaria.
Temporal migraine, red eyes, tinnitus, deafness, stiff neck, facial swelling.
Lumbar and spinal pain, shoulder and back pain, intercostal neuralgia along the lateral body, lateral leg pain.
applications_zh: 維絡全身陽經，調節表裡與全身陽氣。
主解表清熱，和解少陽，疏風止痛。
applications_en: Links and connects all Yang meridians, regulating exterior/interior and Yang Qi.
Releases the exterior, clears heat, harmonizes Shaoyang, and expels wind to stop pain.

pathway_zh: 起於小腿內側（築賓），沿腿內側、少腹（沖門、府舍、大橫、腹哀）、胸脅（期門），上行至咽喉，與任脈會合於天突、廉泉。維絡全身陰經。
pathway_en: Points of the Yinwei channel include: KI 9 Zhubin, SP 12 Chongmen, SP 13 Fushe, LR 14 Qimen, SP 15 Daheng, SP 16 Fuai, CV 22 Tiantu, CV 23 Lianquan. Links all Yin channels.
indications_zh: 心神與胸腹病症：心痛、胸悶、心悸、胃痛、反胃嘔吐、情志鬱結、焦慮失眠。
陰虛與內熱病症：內熱發燒、盜汗、腹痛腹瀉、咽喉腫痛哽噎。
indications_en: Cardiac pain, chest tightness, palpitations, gastralgia, nausea/vomiting, emotional depression, anxiety and insomnia.
Internal heat fever, night sweats, abdominal pain/diarrhea, sore throat and sensation of lump in throat.
applications_zh: 維絡全身陰經，調節心神與陰血氣機。
寬胸理氣，和胃降逆，寧心安神。
applications_en: Links all Yin channels, regulating heart, spirit, and Yin Blood.
Expands the chest, harmonizes the Stomach to lower rebellious Qi, and calms the Shen.
